title: Pink Workwear for a Freezing Office
intro: Every office has one thermostat and it is set for penguins. This is the fix: a soft pink cable cardigan over wide leg trousers, loafers you can walk to the train in, and a tote that fits the laptop. Soft and pink was never the opposite of competent.

images.alt: Shoppable collage on white of a pink cable knit cardigan, beige wide leg trousers, black penny loafers, brown leather laptop tote, pearl stud earrings and a hot pink tumbler.
Woman in a pink cable cardigan and beige wide leg trousers at a farmhouse kitchen island with a brown leather laptop tote, holding a hot pink insulated tumbler.
